column1: # MTP (multi-token prediction) speculation on the Vega 8 iGPU, 2026-09-15.
# llama-bench has no speculative-decoding support at all (no --spec-type flag).
# docs/benchmarks.md warns that the server harness cannot resolve a few percent;
# the effects here are 5-38 %, and the two repeats of every cell agree to ~1 %,
# so the instrument is adequate for this question and for nothing finer.
# Method: ROCm 7.2 baremetal, -ngl 99 -c 8192 -fa on -np 1, iGPU at 2400 MHz.
# One fixed prompt of ~1500 tokens, 256 tokens generated, temperature 0, no
# prompt cache. Each configuration run twice, whole server restarted each time.
# Draft counts are identical across repeats (temperature 0), so acceptance is
# accept       draft_n_accepted / draft_n, from the server's own timings
# mean_len     mean accepted run length, from the server log
